items.title: As Modi pushes lower oil dependence, EVs race ahead of hybrids in India
items.description: India’s EV market is rapidly outpacing petrol hybrids, driven by rising fuel prices, lower taxes and expanding charging infrastructure. Backed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s push to reduce oil imports, EV sales now significantly exceed hybrid sales as consumers increasingly shift toward full electrification.

items.title: What sets apart MNC pharma companies from their Indian counterparts
items.description: Dividend payments by Abbott and Pfizer increased significantly in last two fiscal years even as they lag Indian majors in growth

items.title: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen urges eBay board not to reject $56 billion takeover bid
items.description: EBay on Tuesday rejected a $56 billion takeover bid from the much smaller GameStop over financing doubts, calling the proposal "neither credible nor attractive."

items.title: Cisco to cut about 4,000 jobs in AI-focused restructuring as orders surge
items.description: Cisco, the largest maker of networking equipment, is overhauling products and introducing new ones to better serve data center customers handling AI tasks.

items.title: Ford stock surges 13% on investor optimism for new energy storage business
items.description: The automaker is converting a Kentucky factory for batteries into a facility that builds large storage cells for data centers and utilities.

items.title: Tata Motors to reassess spending pace amid West Asia crisis, says MD Girish Wagh
items.description: Tata Motors is cautiously reviewing expenditure plans amid the West Asia crisis, rising commodity inflation and diesel price concerns, while maintaining its overall capex guidance and forecasting single-digit CV industry growth in FY27

items.title: Import duty hike on gold will spur old gold exchange, dampen sales, says industry
items.description: Late Tuesday night, the government hiked basic customs duty by 10% and imposed a 5% Agriculture Infrastructure and Development Cess on gold and silver imports, taking the effective import tax to 15%.

items.title: OPINION | India’s single window systems still struggle to deliver true reform
items.description: India’s Single Window Systems have improved approvals but major gaps remain. Poor co-ordination and fragmented processes continue to slow businesses and reduce investor trust
